metadata.title: Application Runtime and Execution Boundaries

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for constraining application execution context and limiting blast radius from faults or compromise.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application runtimes, dependency environments, execution permissions, isolation mechanisms, and context boundaries.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for bounding application execution and limiting impact of runtime compromise or failure.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Application execution boundaries assume baseline application purpose, ownership, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Anchors execution isolation, boundary enforcement, and architectural separation between applications and underlying platforms.

metadata.remarks: Application Runtime and Execution Boundaries defines trust properties required to ensure applications execute within constrained and intentional environments. This pattern addresses dependency sprawl, excessive runtime privilege, lateral movement, and blast radius containment, without redefining infrastructure or OS-level controls.

components.title: Runtime Scope and Permission Limitation
components.description: Constrains the privileges and capabilities available to application code at runtime.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of excessive execution privileges to gain broader system access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application runtime operates with least privilege.

components.title: Dependency and Execution Environment Isolation
components.description: Isolates application execution from unrelated code, libraries, and dependencies.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise via shared or ungoverned runtime dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation and lifecycle management of execution dependencies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application runtime dependencies are minimized and isolated.

components.title: Blast Radius and Fault Containment
components.description: Limits the impact of application failure or compromise on other systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement enabled by insufficient execution boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Execution containment and isolation to reduce lateral impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls limit application interaction scope to reduce blast radius.

components.title: Execution Boundary Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into runtime boundary violations and anomalous execution behavior.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to runtime boundary violations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit and telemetry for execution boundary enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Execution boundary violations and anomalies are logged.
Audit review supports investigation of runtime abuse.
